notes: MintGame is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named MINT GAME (MINT) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no external mint, burn or administrative functions and transfers have no tax or fee. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
